title: Civil Engineering Innovation Lab - problem bank
description: 100 real civil, environmental and climate problems for student teams. Each lists a method with its standard or reference, open data sources, Java concepts practised, what the app should show and a stretch goal.

problems.title: Design rainfall IDF curves for Vellore
problems.problem: Engineers designing drains and culverts in Vellore need rainfall intensity for durations from 15 minutes to 24 hours and return periods of 2 to 100 years, but most use values copied from distant cities.
problems.method: Annual maximum daily rainfall series; Gumbel (EV1) frequency analysis by the method of moments; short-duration depths by the IMD empirical one-third power reduction P(t) = P24 (t/24)^(1/3).

data.name: IMD gridded rainfall 0.25 deg (daily, 1901-present)
CHIRPS daily rainfall 0.05 deg
Open-Meteo historical and forecast weather API (CC BY 4.0)

problems.appShows: IDF table and log-log IDF curves, intensity for a chosen duration and return period, CSV export.
problems.stretch: Compare Gumbel with log-Pearson III and show confidence intervals.

problems.title: Village tank storage by the sequent peak method
problems.problem: Tamil Nadu's irrigation tanks (eris) silt up and fail in dry years. How much storage does a tank need to meet a given irrigation demand through a recorded dry spell?
problems.method: Monthly inflow from catchment rainfall (runoff coefficient or SCS-CN) and the sequent peak algorithm (Thomas, 1963) for required storage; mass curve (Rippl) for comparison.

data.name: CHIRPS daily rainfall 0.05 deg
IMD gridded rainfall 0.25 deg (daily, 1901-present)
JRC Global Surface Water (1984-present)
OpenStreetMap (ODbL), query with Overpass Turbo

problems.appShows: Inflow and demand charts, mass curve, required storage and reliability.
problems.stretch: Add evaporation losses from NASA POWER and siltation scenarios.

problems.title: Drought monitor with the Standardized Precipitation Index
problems.problem: Districts of Tamil Nadu declare drought late. A simple SPI dashboard could flag developing drought months earlier.
problems.users: Agriculture department, students of climate risk
problems.method: SPI (McKee, Doesken and Kleist, 1993): fit a gamma distribution to 3, 6 and 12-month rainfall totals and transform to a standard normal variate; drought classes from SPI thresholds.

data.name: CHIRPS daily rainfall 0.05 deg
IMD gridded rainfall 0.25 deg (daily, 1901-present)

problems.appShows: SPI time series, current drought class map for selected grid points.
problems.stretch: Compare SPI with soil moisture from ERA5-Land.

problems.title: Reference evapotranspiration calculator (FAO-56 Penman-Monteith)
problems.problem: Farmers and irrigation planners need daily crop water loss, but ET0 needs many weather variables and a long formula.
problems.method: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith reference evapotranspiration (Allen et al., 1998), with the Hargreaves equation as a check when only temperature is available.

data.name: NASA POWER daily meteorology and solar radiation
Open-Meteo historical and forecast weather API (CC BY 4.0)
FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56 (crop evapotranspiration)

problems.appShows: Daily and monthly ET0 chart, comparison of methods, table of intermediate terms.
problems.stretch: Add a crop coefficient curve to get crop evapotranspiration.

problems.title: Irrigation water requirement for paddy and sugarcane
problems.problem: Vellore district grows paddy and sugarcane with groundwater. How much irrigation water does each crop need per season, after rainfall?
problems.method: Crop evapotranspiration ETc = Kc x ET0 with FAO-56 crop coefficients and growth stages; effective rainfall by the USDA SCS method used in FAO CROPWAT; field application efficiency.

problems.appShows: Ten-day irrigation schedule, seasonal volume per hectare, rainfall contribution.
